'''Zannlyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] for the [[Interplanetary Component Exchange]] aboard [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Cartel Market" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zannlyn first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Cartel Market" />
